Electronic and ionic tortuosities can be obtained from the values of σlf and σif, except in cases with σlf ≈ σif. We find that the morphology and coating of the CAM particles exert a strong influence on the microstructure of the CAM/SE composites and thus on the elec‐ tronic and ionic tortuosities. Sc-NMC622 particles form aggregates, which do not interact strongly with the solid electrolyte particles during the preparation of the composite in a mortar.
